subject: High School Designer Proposal Review
overview: The committee met to share feedback on four design proposals submitted for the high school building project and approved a routine monthly invoice.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the August 11 meeting.

items.title: New Committee Members
items.summary: The committee welcomed Ken Lord and Dr. Kim Talbot as new members.

items.title: Approval of August 2025 Invoice
items.summary: The committee approved the third Owner's Project Manager invoice of $25,000 for August services.

items.title: Review of Designer Proposals
items.summary: Members discussed the advantages, disadvantages, and potential questions regarding high school design proposals from DLR, Perkins&Will, AI3, and SMMA.

items.title: Schedule and Project Updates
items.summary: The committee discussed upcoming Designer Selection Panel meetings and tentative scheduling for the October meeting.
